manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Lift two the medium adult shoe, tips pointing left, into the medium cardboard shoe-box.

Task description: Put the two white adult shoes on the left and right sides of the table into the open cardboard shoebox in front, one behind the other, with both toes pointing left.

Success criteria: Place the shoe initially on the left of the image in the front-central box region near the bottom of the image, and the initially right shoe in the rear-central region near the top. Both must lie flat near the box bottom, soles down and toes pointing left in the image, with both grippers open and releasing them.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping flatter rear-middle shoe sides near the sole's upper edge, with fingers opposing across its width. Match the opening to local width and clearance, reducing slippage from the rounded toe.
- Before closing, confirm the fingers are on opposite shoe sides with sufficient pad contact, avoiding mere image overlap or grasping only laces or tongue. During a short test lift, check for shoe sliding or rotation.
- When turning the shoe's toe, do so where the sole is above the box rim and there is clearance around it. Watch the brown container behind the box and the green-capped bottle at the back right to avoid brushing them with the toe or heel.
- When lowering into the box, leave clearance between the toe, heel, fingers, box rim, and other shoe. Release after the sole is supported, then withdraw through available space to reduce catching on the rim or moving the shoe already placed.
